text: dose of ampicillin 2 or 3 g plus probenecid 1 g • a single intramuscular dose of cefotaxime 500 mg • a single intramuscular dose of cefoxitin 2 g plus oral probenecid 1 g • USA: • a single oral dose of cefixime 400 mg, or • a single intramuscular dose of ceftriaxone 125 mg Other single dose cephalosporins may be substituted. A single intramuscular dose of spectinomycin 2 g is an alternative in patients who cannot tolerate cepha- losporins. • PHARYNGEAL INFECTIONS. • UK: • a single oral dose of ciprofloxacin 500 mg, or • a single oral dose of ofloxacin 400 mg, or • a single intramuscular dose of ceftriaxone 250 mg • USA: • a single intramuscular dose of ceftriaxone 125 mg • GONOCOCCAL INFECTIONS IN PREGNANT WOMEN. • WHO: • a single oral dose of cefixime 400 mg, or • a single intramuscular dose of ceftriaxone 125 mg, or • a single intramuscular dose of spectinomycin 2 g • UK: • a single intramuscular dose of ceftriaxone 250 mg, or • a single intramuscular dose of spectinomycin 2 g, or • a single oral dose of cefixime 400 mg, or • a single oral dose of amoxicillin 3 g (or ampicillin 2 or 3 g) plus probenecid 1 g • USA: • a cephalosporin or spectinomycin • GONOCOCCAL EYE INFECTIONS IN ADULTS. • WHO: frequent irrigation of the infected eye with saline together with: • a single intramuscular dose of ceftriaxone 125 mg, or • a single intramuscular dose of spectinomycin 2 g, or • a single oral dose of ciprofloxacin 500 mg a further alternative is: • a single intramuscular dose of kanamycin 2 g • USA: irrigation of the infected eye with saline togeth- er with: • a single intramuscular dose of ceftriaxone 1 g • DISSEMINATED GONOCOCCAL INFECTIONS IN ADULTS. • WHO: • parenteral ceftriaxone 1 g once daily for 7 days, or • intramuscular spectinomycin 2 g twice daily for 7 days Another third-generation cephalosporin may be sub- stituted if neither of these drugs is available. Treat- ment for endocarditis should continue for 28 days. • USA: • parenteral ceftriaxone 1 g every 24 hours alternatives are: • intravenous ceftizoxime 1 g every 8 hours • cefotaxime 1 g every 8 hours • intramuscular spectinomycin 2 g every 12 hours Once improvement has been established for 24 to 48 hours, oral therapy with cefixime 400 mg twice daily, or cefpodoxime 400 mg twice daily may be substitut- ed until at least a 1-week treatment period is com- plete.
